tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations establish positive gain but cannot calibrate the anticipated reversal near H≈15–25. Acquire the recommended slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-exponential reversal model from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations cover only H≤0.48 and do not identify long-timescale behavior or reliably predict the requested H=21.1 forecast.
Higher resolution of the short-horizon region would not resolve the key long-horizon identifiability gap.
It is unrelated to the identified horizon uncertainty and is explicitly not worth acquiring.
